findings.location: Increment B, Outcome: the window takes the card lock before it plans or runs
findings.problem: The newly specified outer lock conflicts with the existing themerun.run implementation, which acquires cardstate.lock itself. That lock explicitly refuses a second holder even within the same process, so calling themerun.run while the window holds it will refuse every eligible run. Increment A does not include changing lock ownership.
findings.suggestion: Specify a single lock owner across planning and execution, with an internal execution path that uses the already-held lock while preserving locking for manual calls. Include the necessary themerun changes in scope and test successful idle execution through the real locking path.

summary: The added lock requirement introduces nested acquisition of a non-reentrant lock, preventing theme execution.
